sop_chunks_pages.name: sop_chunks_pages
sop_chunks_pages.value: ("app"."sop_chunks"."page_start" is null or "app"."sop_chunks"."page_start" >= 1) and ("app"."sop_chunks"."page_end" is null or ("app"."sop_chunks"."page_start" is not null and "app"."sop_chunks"."page_end" >= "app"."sop_chunks"."page_start"))

workflow_jobs_kind_state.name: workflow_jobs_kind_state
workflow_jobs_kind_state.value: ("app"."workflow_jobs"."kind" = 'synthetic_probe' and "app"."workflow_jobs"."scenario" in ('success','validation_failure') and "app"."workflow_jobs"."scenario" is not null and "app"."workflow_jobs"."attempt_deadline" is not null and "app"."workflow_jobs"."state" <> 'WAITING_FOR_PIPELINE' and "app"."workflow_jobs"."document_id" is null and "app"."workflow_jobs"."source_sha256" is null and "app"."workflow_jobs"."pipeline_version" is null) or ("app"."workflow_jobs"."kind" = 'document_ingestion' and "app"."workflow_jobs"."scenario" is null and "app"."workflow_jobs"."document_id" is not null and "app"."workflow_jobs"."source_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' and "app"."workflow_jobs"."source_sha256" is not null and "app"."workflow_jobs"."pipeline_version" is not null and (("app"."workflow_jobs"."state" = 'WAITING_FOR_PIPELINE' and "app"."workflow_jobs"."attempt_deadline" is null and "app"."workflow_jobs"."dispatch_count" = 0 and "app"."workflow_jobs"."dispatch_lease_token" is null and "app"."workflow_jobs"."dispatch_lease_until" is null and "app"."workflow_jobs"."dispatch_accepted_at" is null and "app"."workflow_jobs"."run_lease_until" is null and "app"."workflow_jobs"."execution_id" is null and "app"."workflow_jobs"."step" = 0 and "app"."workflow_jobs"."attempt_number" = 1) or ("app"."workflow_jobs"."state" in ('QUEUED','RUNNING','COMPLETED','FAILED') and "app"."workflow_jobs"."attempt_deadline" is not null)))

workflow_jobs_attempt_bounds.name: workflow_jobs_attempt_bounds
workflow_jobs_attempt_bounds.value: "app"."workflow_jobs"."attempt_number" between 1 and 3 and "app"."workflow_jobs"."dispatch_count" between 0 and 3 and "app"."workflow_jobs"."step" between 0 and 5
